editorial_cautions.note: Franc/euro prices retained as historical source context; no current price inference.
Demographic/statistical/travel/employment context is historical; homeopathy page is read as language data, not treatment recommendation.

Images checked: printed é in rule explanation but lève in examples; printed je prend/partirent/croirons are source errors, not OCR errors. Printed en index repeats109. Handwritten notes read visually. Companion uses standard forms; source unmodified.
Rules have scope limits: reflexive agreement; demonstrative ça; imperative tu final -s; infinitive groups do not determine every irregular form.

visual_checks.finding: Printed explanation says é but conjugation examples correctly show lève; companion explains è.
Read both handwritten thank-you notes; Sophie/Pierre use tu and grosses bises, Brigitte/Philippe use vous and amicalement.
Printed je prend is a source typo, standard je prends.
Printed ils partirent/ils croirons in future column are source typos, standard partiront/croiront.
Original index has en 79,109 and y 109; printed249 is publication advert.

limits: This is content review for original companions, not certification of complete glyph-level OCR correction or original-audio answers.
